segments.ja155:1.1: Jīva vassasataṃ bhagga [gagga (sī. pī.)], aparāni ca vīsatiṃ [vīsati (syā. ka.)];
segments.ja155:1.3: Mā maṃ pisācā khādantu, jīva tvaṃ sarado sataṃ.
segments.ja155:2.1: Tvampi vassasataṃ jīva, aparāni ca vīsatiṃ;
segments.ja155:2.3: Visaṃ pisācā khādantu, jīva tvaṃ sarado satanti.

lines: Aparāni ca vīsatinti aparāni ca vīsati vassāni jīva.
Mā maṃ pisācā khādantūti maṃ pisācā mā khādantu.
Jīva tvaṃ saradosatanti tvaṃ pana vīsuttaraṃ vassasataṃ jīvāti.
Saradosatañhi gaṇiyamānaṃ vassasatameva hoti, taṃ purimehi vīsāya saddhiṃ vīsuttaraṃ idha adhippetaṃ.
Yakkho bodhisattassa vacanaṃ sutvā “imaṃ tāva māṇavaṃ ‘jīvā’ti vuttattā khādituṃ na sakkā, pitaraṃ panassa khādissāmī”ti pitu santikaṃ agamāsi.
“ayaṃ so ‘paṭijīvā’ti abhaṇantānaṃ khādakayakkho bhavissati, paṭijīvaṃ karissāmī”ti.
Visaṃ pisācā khādantu, jīva tvaṃ saradosatan”ti.
Tattha visaṃ pisācā khādantūti pisācā halāhalavisaṃ khādantu.
